candidates.reason: Role-for-role combat draw plus conditional recursion and a trampling Vehicle; documented mandatory draw/artifact exposure.
Convoke gives permanent flying counters to multiple Pirates, materially improving subsequent three-Pirate connections.
Recent six-mana theft Pirate is powerful but does not improve early three-Pirate connection reliability.
Delayed ascend-dependent single-body evasion is narrower than Zephyr's team-wide flying counters.
One-shot X-cost evasion/draw is less repeatable than persistent flying counters.
Vehicle anthem overlaps current pumps but adds no Pirate body.
Five-mana copy value has uncertain Pirate-count effect and weak immediate evasion.
Raid copy timing and copied types undermine reliable Pirate threshold.
Flying Pirate disruption is useful but less broadly impactful than persistent multi-Pirate evasion.
Four-mana Treasure value does not directly bypass blockers.
Artifact-entry counters raise damage but do not guarantee three separate connections.
Interaction upgrade not demonstrated against retained premium counters.
Flexible theft/cast utility is meta-dependent and not essential to connection plan.
Combat value at four mana does not beat prioritized team evasion.
Five-mana anthem/draw competes with faster existing tribal payoffs.

red_team_findings.claim: Tapping Pirates to convoke may prevent same-turn attacks; flying counters mainly pay off in subsequent combats.
red_team_findings.resolution: Recorded as a genuine sequencing cost; use precombat convoke only when later connection payoff outweighs current attack.

red_team_findings.claim: Mandatory triggers and artifact vulnerability can be worse than Coastal Piracy.
red_team_findings.resolution: Accept as a bounded role-for-role tradeoff because of 6/6 trample body and conditional graveyard recast.

red_team_findings.claim: A Vehicle replacing an enchantment could dilute the Pirate engine.
red_team_findings.resolution: Both original and replacement are non-Pirates; Pirate creature count is unchanged by either swap.

red_team_findings.claim: Tutors/free interaction might dominate the Pirate theft identity.
red_team_findings.resolution: Retained staples protect/enable the primary three-Pirate connection and theft strategy rather than substituting a generic combo finish.

red_team_findings.claim: The October 2026 Jhoira release was absent from older rankings.
red_team_findings.resolution: Reviewed current release and rejected for six-mana curve and poor threshold support.

commander_necessity.thesis: Beckett converts combat damage from three distinct Pirates to the same player into recurring permanent theft; the deck's token/evasion package exists to satisfy that condition.

evidence_dimensions.name: commander_identity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Two swaps directly reinforce three-Pirate combat connection.

evidence_dimensions.name: engine
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Evasion, tokens, combat payoffs, theft and draw remain coherent.

evidence_dimensions.name: mana
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Four-mana Zephyr has convoke; current land/ramp unchanged, but no controlled multiplayer curve comparison.

evidence_dimensions.name: interaction
evidence_dimensions.rationale: All premium interaction and protection retained.

evidence_dimensions.name: resilience
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Indomitable graveyard recast improves recursion but no exhaustive matchup trials.

evidence_dimensions.name: conversion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Flying counters improve likelihood of repeatable commander theft triggers.

evidence_dimensions.name: combo_integrity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No novel combo is asserted by the swaps; convoke and graveyard casting are interpreted conservatively.

evidence_dimensions.name: card_quality
evidence_dimensions.rationale: 15 serious alternative candidates explicitly considered against existing slots.

evidence_dimensions.name: candidate_exhaustion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Recent release checked and high-impact candidate dispositions closed.

evidence_dimensions.name: testing
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No controlled multiplayer test claimed; swaps justified analytically, not by invented win rates.

evidence_dimensions.name: rules_confidence
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Existing source audit plus targeted Oracle/legality checks of both additions.

evidence_dimensions.name: source_freshness
evidence_dimensions.rationale: 2026-10-13 source snapshot and Oct 2026 Jhoira discovery cross-check.
